typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		CASEID as string,
		REPORT_TYPE as string,
		ERROR_TYPE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT CASEID, REPORT_TYPE,ERROR_TYPE FROM EXTRACT.KS_GandA_ErrorReport',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of ERROR_TYPE} = toString(ERROR_TYPE),
		{Copy of CASEID} = toString(CASEID),
		{Copy of REPORT_TYPE} = toString(REPORT_TYPE)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
